```lean
import Lean

def timSort[T : Type](a : Array T) : Array T :=
  let mut a := a
  let mut runLength := 0
  let mut maxRunLength := 0
  let mut i := 0

  while i < a.size do
    if i + runLength < a.size && a[i] < a[i + runLength] then
      let j := i
      while i + runLength < a.size && a[i] < a[i + runLength + 1] do
        runLength := runLength + 1
      end while
      if runLength > maxRunLength then
        maxRunLength := runLength
      end if
      a.swap i (i + runLength)
      runLength := 0
    else
      runLength := runLength + 1
      i := i + 1
    end if
  end while

  let n := a.size
  let log2n := (n).log2
  let log2n := (n).log2.floor
  let log2n := (n).log2.ceiling
  let log2n := (n).log2.floor
  let log2n := (n).log2.ceiling

  for i in 0..(n / 2) do
    let half := n / 2
    let j := n - half - 1
    if i < j then
      a.swap i j
    end if
    half := half / 2
    j := j - half - 1
  end for

  for i in 0..(log2n) do
    let k := 1 << i
    let j := k - 1
    for j in 0..(n - k) do
      let l := j + k
      let m := j + k + k
      if a[j] > a[l] then
        if l < m && a[l] > a[m] then
          a.swap j l
          a.swap l m
        end if
      end if
    end for
  end for

  a

end timSort
```

The code starts by initializing the `runLength` and `maxRunLength` variables to keep track of the length of the current run and the maximum run length found so far. The `i` variable is used to iterate through the array.

The algorithm then enters a loop that runs until it has processed the entire array. In each iteration of the loop, it checks if the current element and the next element are in the correct order. If they are not, it finds the end of the run and swaps the elements to bring them into order.

After the initial pass, the algorithm enters a series of merging passes, where it combines adjacent runs of the array. The number of merging passes is determined by the logarithm of the array size.

Finally, the algorithm returns the sorted array.

```lean
import Data.List
import Data.Maybe
import Data.Array

def timsort [a] (xs: Array a): Array a :=
  let array := xs.toImmutableArray
  let sorted := timSort array
  sorted.toImmutableArray

private def minRun (n: Nat): Nat :=
  let k := n.bit0
  if k == 0 then 32 else k / 2

private def gallopLeft (a: Nat, key: Nat, offset: Nat, high: Nat): Nat :=
  let (l, m, h) := (a, key - offset, high)
  let (l, m, h) := (l + 1, l, h - 1)
  while h - l > 1 do
    let mid := l + (h - l) / 2
    match cmp key (array[mid]) with
    | Ordering.lt => h := mid
    | Ordering.gt => l := mid + 1
    | Ordering.eq => return mid
  mid

private def gallopRight (a: Nat, key: Nat, offset: Nat, high: Nat): Nat :=
  let (l, m, h) := (a, key - offset, high)
  let (l, m, h) := (l + 1, l, h - 1)
  while h - l > 1 do
    let mid := l + (h - l) / 2
    match cmp key (array[mid]) with
    | Ordering.lt => l := mid + 1
    | Ordering.gt => h := mid
    | Ordering.eq => return mid
  mid

private def binarySearch (a: Nat, key: Nat, offset: Nat, high: Nat): Nat :=
  let (l, m, h) := (a, key - offset, high)
  while h - l > 1 do
    let mid := l + (h - l) / 2
    match cmp key (array[mid]) with
    | Ordering.lt => h := mid
    | Ordering.gt => l := mid + 1
    | Ordering.eq => return mid
  m

private def insertionSort (a: Nat, high: Nat): Unit :=
  let array := array.toImmutableArray
  for i in a..<high do
    let key := array[i]
    let j := i - 1
    while j >= 0 && cmp array[j] key > Ordering.lt do
      array[j + 1] := array[j]
      j := j - 1
    array[j + 1] := key

private def merge (a: Nat, aux: Array a, high: Nat, mid: Nat, offset: Nat): Unit :=
  let lo := a
  let hi := mid + 1
  while lo <= mid && hi <= high do
    match cmp array[lo] array[hi] with
    | Ordering.lt => aux[hi - offset] := array[lo]
    | Ordering.gt => aux[hi - offset] := array[hi]
    | Ordering.eq => aux[hi - offset] := array[lo]; aux[hi - offset] := array[hi]
    hi := hi + 1
  let (lo, hi) := (lo + 1, hi)
  for i in lo..mid do
    aux[hi - offset] := array[i]
    hi := hi + 1

private def timSort (array: ImmutableArray a): ImmutableArray a :=
  let n := array.size
  let aux := array.mkArray n
  let runCount := 0
  let minRun := minRun n
  for i in 0..n - minRun do
    insertionSort i (i + minRun - 1)
    runCount := runCount + 1
  for length in [minRun..n] do
    let a := gallopLeft 0 array[length] 0 length
    let b := gallopRight a array[length] 0 length
    if a < b then
      merge a aux b (a + length) 0
    else
      merge (b - length) aux a (b - length) 0
  runCount := 0
  for i in 0..n - 1 do
    let j := binarySearch (i + minRun) array[n] 0 n
    let k := binarySearch (j + minRun) array[n] 0 n
    if j <= k then
      insertionSort j (k - 1)
    runCount := runCount + 1
  array
```
